title: Sister Maria's flame in the convent cell

tellings.quote: in the late 1800s while sleeping in her small cell in a Catholic Convent a young nun named sister Maria was awakened by a shining object like a flame that appeared to emerge from her room's wall and hover above her

plain: A young nun named Sister Maria, asleep in her small cell in a Catholic convent, is said to have woken to see a shining object like a flame come out of the wall and hover above her. Michels tells it himself, placing it in the late 1800s, in an episode with the religion scholar Diana Pasulka about links between UFOs and religion. He tells it because the scene looks a lot like modern accounts of glowing lights appearing to people in their bedrooms.
